description: This Java class 'SubstitutionStrategyRegistry' functions as a registry that maintains a list of 'SubstitutionStrategy' instances. It provides methods to retrieve a matching strategy based on 'WithDittoHeaders' and creates a predefined set of strategies for substitution purposes, likely used in enforcement or policy management within the project.

classes.name: SubstitutionStrategyRegistry
classes.description: Immutable registry class that maintains a list of substitution strategies and provides matching logic.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the registry with predefined strategies.

methods.name: getMatchingStrategy
methods.description: Returns an optional strategy matching the provided 'WithDittoHeaders'.

methods.name: getStrategies
methods.description: Returns the list of strategies contained in the registry (package-private for testing).
